wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |CoachRank = |APRank = |mode = basketball |year = 2019–20 |team = North Alabama Lions |image = North Alabama Lions wordmark.svg |image_size = 250 |logo = |logo_size = 250 |conference = Atlantic Sun Conference |short_conf = ASUN |record = 13–17 |conf_record = 8–8 |head_coach = [[Tony Pujol]] |hc_year = 2nd |asst_coach1 = Ahmad Smith |asst_coach2 = Willie Watson |asst_coach3 = Tom Berryman |stadium = [[Flowers Hall]] |champion = |bowl= |bowl_result = }} {{2019–20 Atlantic Sun men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Alabama]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lions, led by second-year head coach [[Tony Pujol]], played their home games at [[Flowers Hall]] in [[Florence, Alabama]] as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]] (ASUN). They finished the season 13–17, 8–8 in ASUN play, to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] to [[2019–20 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]].{{Cite web |date=2020-03-03 |title=LIONS COME UP SHORT IN ASUN QUARTERFINALS |url=https://roarlions.com/news/2020/3/3/mens-basketball-lions-come-up-short-in-asun-quarterfinals.aspx |access-date=2025-08-26 |website=University of North Alabama Athletics |language=en}} This season will mark North Alabama's second of a four-year transition period from [[NCAA Division II|Division II]] to [[NCAA Division I|Division I]]. As a result, the Lions are not eligible for NCAA postseason play but can participate in the [[2020 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]]. They could have also played in the [[CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] or [[College Basketball Invitational|CBI]], if invited. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team|Lions]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 10–22 overall, 7–9 in ASUN play, to finish in a tie for sixth place. In the [[2019 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]], they were defeated by [[2018–19 North Florida Ospreys men's basketball team|North Florida]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news |date=March 4, 2019 |title=UNA MEN FALL IN ASUN QUARTERFINALS |url=https://roarlions.com/news/2019/3/4/mens-basketball-una-men-fall-in-asun-quarterfinals.aspx |access-date=September 23, 2019
